correctness.rationale: Write D_i=sum_{t=i}^{n-1} B_(i,t), use conditional S_j(n)=(n/(t+1))S_j(t+1) when t>=j, and conditional parent location. The probability a fixed vertex i belongs to j-subtree is zero for i<j, one for i=j, and 1/j for i>j. This gives Cov(B_(i,t),S_j(n))=n[p_(ij)-1/j]/[t(t+1)] for t>=max(i,j). For t<j the future j-subtree is independent of that earlier parent choice. Telescoping yields exactly the claimed triangular matrix and zero boundary columns; sum over i is zero because total offspring n-1 is deterministic. Independently enumerated every parent sequence n=2..7 using exact fractions, checking every i,j.
